abstract: Gynecologic malignancies account for approximately 2% of all childhood cancers, 60-70% of which are ovarian in origin. New therapeutic modalities have resulted in a significant increase in survival rates for these young patients. Recent advances in the management of germ cell and sex cord tumors of the ovary have resulted not only in an increase in cure rates but also in simultaneous preservation of future fertility. The recent advent of surgical staging has elucidated the early sites of subclinical or occult metastases that accounted for the high mortality in patients who were previously presumed to have localized ovarian cancer. Treatment options are discussed for the various classes of ovarian tumors in children, at the hand of experience at the authors' institution, and of others.
abstract_ja: 小児の婦人科悪性腫瘍は小児がん全体の約2%を占め、その60～70%は卵巣由来である。胚細胞腫瘍および性索間質腫瘍の治療の進歩により、治癒率が上昇するとともに、将来の妊孕性の温存も同時に可能になった。近年の外科的病期分類の導入により、従来は局所限局と考えられていた卵巣癌患者において、高い死亡率の原因となっていた早期の潜在的転移部位が明らかになった。著者らの施設の経験および他施設の報告に基づき、小児卵巣腫瘍の各分類に対する治療選択肢を論じる。
